designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the San Andres National Wildlife Refuge by Executive Order 8646 on January 22, 1941 to conserve desert bighorn sheep.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (FWS) and Pass B (order text; National Archives table) agree on the order and year. The FWS Realty record dates the order January 23, 1941; the American Presidency Project and the National Archives table both give January 22, 1941 (published 6 FR 592, January 25, 1941), so January 22 is used.

sources.name: National Archives, Executive Orders Disposition Tables, 1941 (6 FR 592)
